what: parameters of the production local solder-joint model (the L0-L3 submodel behind every published local response), with sources and calibration ranges

elastic.kind: ASSUMPTION anchored on a sourced room-temperature range
elastic.source: E_ref = midpoint of the 40-50 GPa room-temperature band of Z. Paska et al., 'Comparison of tensile and creep properties of SAC305 and SACX0807 at room temperature with DIC application', Appl. Sci. 14(2):604, 2024, doi:10.3390/app14020604; the slope and nu are assumptions (solder_model.py: 'swept in the sensitivity study')
elastic.calibrated_range: room temperature only (no temperature dependence in the source)

yield_and_hardening.law: bilinear *PLASTIC: sigma_y = sigma_0(T) at eps_in = 0 rising linearly to sigma_0 + C/gamma at eps_in = 0.02, constant beyond; ISOTROPIC hardening on the accumulated equivalent inelastic strain (PEEQ)
yield_and_hardening.kind: FIT (two model layers from measurement) + modelling choice
yield_and_hardening.source: C. Yuan, Q. Su, K.-N. Chiang, 'Coefficient extraction of SAC305 solder constitutive equations using equation-informed neural networks', Materials 16(14):4922, 2023, doi:10.3390/ma16144922, Table 10 Chaboche fit (to stress-strain curves generated by an Anand model fitted to Motalab et al. SAC305 data); card rows interpolated linearly in T, clamped above 122 C; the saturation strain 0.02 is a modelling choice (solder_model.py)
yield_and_hardening.cross_check: Z. Paska et al., 'Comparison of tensile and creep properties of SAC305 and SACX0807 at room temperature with DIC application', Appl. Sci. 14(2):604, 2024, doi:10.3390/app14020604: measured Rp0.2 = 23.3-25.6 MPa at room temperature vs sigma_0(25 C) = 24.46 MPa
yield_and_hardening.role_in_VISCO: no rate-independent plastic flow occurs in a *VISCO step; sigma_y(T, PEEQ) is the threshold of the overstress creep law (results/phase0l/CALCULIX_CREEP_IMPLEMENTATION_AUDIT.md (CalculiX 2.23 source incplas.f / creeps.f / materialdata_me.f, confirmed by solver probes))

creep.solver_law: eps_dot_in = A(T) <sigma_vm - sigma_y(T, PEEQ)>^n(T) t^m, m = 0 (CalculiX *CREEP LAW=NORTON with *PLASTIC = overstress law; no creep below sigma_y)
creep.units: A in 1/(s MPa^n), sigma in MPa
creep.data: Q. Xiao and W. D. Armstrong, 'Tensile creep and microstructural characterization of bulk Sn3.9Ag0.6Cu lead-free solder', J. Electron. Mater. 34(2):196-211, 2005, doi:10.1007/s11664-005-0233-z (data as tabulated in Yuan 2023 Table 5); 19 steady-state points at 45/80/115/150 C
creep.card_row_rule: rows at -40..125 C: n linear in T between the measured temperatures (constant = n(45 C) below 45 C); A from an Arrhenius fit of the rate at sigma_ref = 10 MPa (apparent Q = 64.4 kJ/mol)

calibrated_range.fitted_variable: applied (von Mises) stress, NOT the overstress the solver uses

caveats: alloy of the creep data is Sn3.9Ag0.6Cu, not SAC305 (DEFECT #41)

between rows (25 C apart) the solver interpolates A linearly, not as built (Arrhenius in rate): at the tier joints the solver's creep rate is 1.2-3.5x the intended one (solver_vs_intended_at_tier_joints); rebuilding the same card on 2.5 C rows changes the response by the d_eps_card_grid_sensitivity_rel listed there
the card was fitted in sigma_vm but the solver integrates the overstress sigma_vm - sigma_y (DEFECT #40): it does not reproduce its own calibration data (Phase 0L, Part IV TEST F)
the solver interpolates A and n linearly between rows and clamps outside -40..125 C (a joint at 140.3 C, Z1 HV-S1, uses the 125 C row)
incplas.f replaces any A t^m < 1e-20 by 1e-20 (the -40 C row, 4.0e-22, is never visited)

copper_pads.kind: handbook-type constants, hard-coded in joint.write_inp (no temperature dependence; elastic only)
copper_pads.note: the package model's copper (final_closure_physical_etm) uses the same E = 117 GPa

geometry.source: Krishnakumar et al., IEEE TCPMT 16(9):2089-2102, 2026, Table III (bib key Krishnakumar2026DVPD); configs/phase0nx/z1_physical.yaml bga
geometry.solder_shape: equal-area square prism (the convention the global ball-array homogenisation uses)

averaging_band.source: local_mesh_policy.json amendment 5 (fixed physical width = one L0 element)

mesh.production_level_reported: L0 in the tier table (Table II); L3 is the declared production level of the mesh study

boundary_conditions.top_pad_face_NTOP: u_y = u_z = 0; u_x = du (hot half-cycle), 0 (cold half)
boundary_conditions.temperature: uniform field on every node (NALL), prescribed per step
boundary_conditions.global_to_local: du = |u_top - u_bottom|_xy across the ball layer at the critical site and T_joint at that site, from the package thermoelastic solve on the converged electrothermal field

loading_cycle.ramp: none: temperature and displacement change as STEP functions at the start of each half-cycle (the .dat shows the new joint temperature at the first increment, t = 2e-3 s; local_mesh_policy.json amendment 2)
loading_cycle.load_split: each 300 s half-cycle = a 3 s step that applies the change + a 297 s hold at the same loads (amendment 3c; numerical only)

time_integration.CETOL_meaning: limit on the change of inelastic strain RATE across an increment (incplas.f state variable 14)
time_integration.solver_floor: CalculiX does not cut below 1e-6 x step period (3e-6 s in the 3 s step; amendment 1)

response.name: d_eps_in (d_peeq_per_cycle)
response.definition: increment over the last (4th) cycle of the volume-averaged accumulated equivalent inelastic strain (PEEQ = sum of sqrt(2/3) |d eps_in|) of the solder core ESOLCORE
response.averaging: element PEEQ = mean of its 8 integration points; element volume weights (EVOL)

stress_experienced_by_production_card.versus_calibration: the creep card was calibrated on 7.5-15.9 MPa; the joints creep at 20-210 MPa under this card
stress_experienced_by_production_card.weighting: von Mises of element-mean stress, last cycle, solder core; strain-weighted = d(PEEQ) x volume (where the inelastic strain is deposited), time-weighted = dt x volume (where the cycle is spent)

manuscript_citation_gap: manuscript_v2 does not cite the sources of the card (Xiao & Armstrong 2005, Yuan 2023, Paska 2024); Schubert 2003 and Motalab 2012 are already in refs.bib

sources.xiao2005: Q. Xiao and W. D. Armstrong, 'Tensile creep and microstructural characterization of bulk Sn3.9Ag0.6Cu lead-free solder', J. Electron. Mater. 34(2):196-211, 2005, doi:10.1007/s11664-005-0233-z (data as tabulated in Yuan 2023 Table 5)
sources.yuan2023: C. Yuan, Q. Su, K.-N. Chiang, 'Coefficient extraction of SAC305 solder constitutive equations using equation-informed neural networks', Materials 16(14):4922, 2023, doi:10.3390/ma16144922
sources.paska2024: Z. Paska et al., 'Comparison of tensile and creep properties of SAC305 and SACX0807 at room temperature with DIC application', Appl. Sci. 14(2):604, 2024, doi:10.3390/app14020604
sources.krishnakumar2026: Krishnakumar et al., IEEE TCPMT 16(9):2089-2102, 2026, Table III (bib key Krishnakumar2026DVPD); configs/phase0nx/z1_physical.yaml bga
sources.audit: results/phase0l/CALCULIX_CREEP_IMPLEMENTATION_AUDIT.md (CalculiX 2.23 source incplas.f / creeps.f / materialdata_me.f, confirmed by solver probes)
